newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-SOUNESS IN TALKS WITH TORINO.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SOUNESS IN TALKS WITH TORINO.

text.p: Graeme Souness met Torino president Massimo Vidulich on the Italian Riviera on Sunday to discuss a deal which would take the former Liverpool and Southampton manager to the serie B club.
The two met in the resort of Portofino for the first time to discuss terms and the club was confident of a positive outcome to the talks.
Souness resigned as manager of Southampton last month, less than a year after joining them from Turkish club Galatasaray where he was sacked.
The former Scottish international captain, who played in Italy with Sampdoria, has been closely linked to Torino.
